title: FigMirror: Ground It, Code It, Plot It
abstract: arXiv:2608.28814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Converting scientific figures into executable code has gained increasing attention, yet existing methods primarily focus on reproducing the reference figure itself. A more practical setting is to plot new data while preserving the visual style of a reference figure (e.g., color scheme and typography). Prior approaches mimic the reference through pixel-level optimization and struggle to carry its style to new data. We show that the key to this task lies in the coordinate grounding and coding capabilities present in modern computer-use models. We propose FigMirror, an agentic framework that unlocks these capabilities through Grounded Measurement, which locates visual elements by coordinates and measures their properties through executable code. translated_abstract: 将科学图表转换为可执行代码正日益受到关注，然而现有方法主要聚焦于复现参考图本身。一个更实用的设定是在保留参考图视觉风格（如配色方案和字体排版）的同时绘制新数据。以往方法通过像素级优化来模仿参考图，难以将其风格迁移到新数据上。我们证明该任务的关键在于现代计算机使用模型中已具备的坐标定位与代码编写能力。我们提出FigMirror，一个智能体框架，通过“接地测量”来释放这些能力，即通过坐标定位视觉元素并通过可执行代码测量其属性。我们进一步提出PlotTwin-Bench，一个由专家精心构建的基准，包含细粒度的代码级和图像级风格评估指标。实验表明，FigMirror在各项评估上持续优于现有方法。
tldr: 提出FigMirror智能体框架，利用计算机使用模型的坐标定位与代码编写能力，在保留参考图视觉风格的前提下绘制新数据，并发布专家构建的PlotTwin-Bench风格评估基准。
en_tdlr: FigMirror is an agentic framework that leverages the coordinate grounding and coding capabilities of computer-use models to plot new data while preserving a reference figure's visual style, accompanied by the expert-curated PlotTwin-Bench benchmark.
